column1: # M0 regression corpus manifest. One row per program; columns are whitespace-separated,
# the description is the rest of the line. dev/corpus.sh asserts each program's result
# symbol (read from build/<name>.map at the size the map records) against `expected`.
# Add a program: drop a .c in examples/snes/corpus/ that writes `corpus_result`, build,
# run it, and record the value here with its derivation commented in the source.
hello.c             sentinel       0x42      liveness: main runs (the smoke ROM)
corpus/structs.c    corpus_result  0x0340    struct layout + pointer deref

column4: Space Invaders deterministic attract sim, 600 frames (shared invaders_logic.h)
spirograph (R,r,d) hypo/epi/rose/lissajous curve-point hash, 32 pts x 4 modes (shared spiro.h)
spirograph interactive controller + HUD-format math over a scripted pad sequence (shared spirograph.h)
π spigot (PI_GATE_DIGITS=1, PI_ELEMS=676, a[0]=0) + MC (PI_GATE_THROWS=256) gate CRC (shared pi_spigot.h)
1-D CA: 32 Rule-90 + 32 Rule-110 gens from single-cell seed; CRC-16 of all output rows (shared ca1d.h)
Gray-Scott cumulative gate_crc (16-bit fixed-point, scale 4096; GS_GATE_W=8, GS_GATE_H=8, GS_GATE_STEPS=8; DU=655/DV=328/F=150/K=254)
N-body (N=3, GRAV_K=64, GRAV_SOFT=16, DT_SHIFT=4) Symplectic Euler, 32 steps, rotate-XOR CRC
Bignum factorial 50! in base-10000 uint16 array; carry-mul + __mulsi3 + __udivmodsi4 (shared factorial.h)
Newton's-method fractal z³−1, 8×8 grid in [−1.2,1.2]², 20-iter cap; complex division + multiply (shared newton.h)
CORDIC rotator full-circle sweep (GATE_N=96): rotation cordic16_sincos + vectoring cordic16_atan2, shift-add only → zero mul/div libcalls (shared cordic.h)
Maze recursive-division generate + A* indexed-heap solve (16x15) gate CRC: walls + path + heap counters (shared maze.h)
Doom-fire heat field: 16x16 grid, 30 steps; per-cell xorshift16 PRNG + flat-index array sweep (multiply-free), rotate-XOR CRC of full grid each step (shared doom-fire.h)
Conway's Game of Life B3/S23: Gosper gun on 64x48 bitpacked grid, 32 gens; SWAR bit-parallel neighbour sums (and/eor/ora + asl/lsr, multiply-free), CRC-16 of all output rows (shared life.h)
Fourier epicycles: sum of 8 rotating vectors (DFT of a star) traces the outline; 4 __mulsi3/harmonic + 32-bit accumulate, no divide (shared epicycles.h)
Julia set z^2+c escape-time: 4 keyframe c's (0.7885*e^itheta orbit, 90 deg steps) over a 6x6 grid, maxiter 8; 3 __mulsi3/iter Q5.10 complex multiply (shared julia.h)

Lissajous/harmonograph: 4 damped pendulums (2/axis, detuned), 256 samples preset 0; 8 __mulsi3/sample (sin·env amplitude + env·decay envelope), sin LUT, rotate-XOR hash, no divide (shared harmonograph.h)
Raycaster maze DDA grid-cast: 64-column fan from a fixed camera, 16x16 map; 3 __udivsi3/column (deltaDist reciprocals + screen_h/dist), Q8.8 fixed-point + sin LUT (shared raycaster.h)
Burning Ship fractal (|Re|,|Im| fold): 16x16 window over the ship, maxiter 24; 3 __mulsi3/iter (zx2,zy2,|zx*zy|) Q12 + 2 abs folds, escape-time hash, no divide (shared burning_ship.h)
